name: Hyman Cannabis | 1.2g Handroll | Sosa Sherb
description:
Strain Type: Hybrid

Mood : Peaceful & Relaxed

Flavor & Aroma : Berry & Creamy

This isn’t just any pre-roll — it’s a whole nug experience. Each Handcraft is rolled with 1 full A-NUG of HYMAN flower, never broken down or blended. Finished with a glass tip and H2O brushed for an even, flavorful burn. One nug. One roll. One unforgettable smoke.
